issues.description: The problem text explicitly instructs students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public for easier testing, but both the template and the reference solution declare this method as private (and the template currently has the parameter commented out). This visibility mismatch can confuse students and may break tests that expect a public helper method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make singFarmSongVerse accept an Animal parameter and change its visibility to public in the template and reference solution (i.e., public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) { ... }). Ensure the template method signature includes the Animal parameter rather than commenting it out so students implement the method exactly as described.
